description_en: Retrieves the list of gateway tuple tickets submitted by the user
description_zh: 获取用户已提交的网关元组工单列表
name: ListGatewayTupleOrders

parameters.help_en:
The filter list of ticket statuses. If this parameter is not specified, tickets in all statuses are queried. Valid values:

APPLYING: The ticket is being applied for.

REJECTED: The ticket is rejected.

ACCEPTING: The ticket is being dispatched.

ACCEPTED: The ticket is dispatched.

ACCEPTING_FAILED: The ticket fails to be dispatched.

REVOKING: The ticket is being revoked.

REVOKED: The ticket is revoked.

REVOKING_FAILED: The ticket fails to be revoked
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态过滤列表，若不使用此参数，则表示查询所有状态的工单。可取值为：

APPLYING：申请中。

REJECTED：已拒绝。

ACCEPTING：分发中。

ACCEPTED：分发成功。

ACCEPTING_FAILED：分发失败。

REVOKING：撤回中。

REVOKED：撤回成功。

REVOKING_FAILED：撤回失败
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the current query. The value starts from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of tickets to return in the current query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的工单数量上限，需大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the query results. Valid values:

CREATED_MILLIS: Sorts the results by the time when the ticket was submitted.

ACCEPTED_MILLIS: Sorts the results by the time when the ticket was approved
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序字段。可取值为：

CREATED_MILLIS：根据工单发起时间排序。

ACCEPTED_MILLIS：根据工单审批通过时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending order. This parameter must be used together with the SortingField parameter. Valid values:

true: Sorts the results in ascending order.

false: Sorts the results in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
需配合SortingField参数一起使用。

true：表示升序。

false：表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of queried gateway key ticket information
List.description_zh: 查询到的网关密钥工单信息列表

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved. Unit: milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

CreatedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was submitted. Unit: milliseconds
CreatedMillis.description_zh: 提交此工单的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

OrderId.description_en: The order ID of the gateway key

OrderState.description_en: The application status of the gateway key

RequiredCount.description_en: The number of gateway keys to be issued

TupleType.description_en:
The gateway key type. Valid values:

singlechannel: The low-speed edition (single-channel).

standard: The standard edition.

hybrid: The high-speed edition (hybrid).

noncontractual: The high-speed edition
TupleType.description_zh:
网关密钥类型。

singlechannel：低速版（单通道型）。

standard：标准版。

hybrid：高速版（Hybrid型）。

noncontractual：高速版

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tickets that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的工单总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
